title: Brain implants let paralyzed people paint and move with thought alone
title_candidates: A paralyzed woman is painting again, using only a chip inside her brain
What Neuralink actually does when its chip sits inside a paralyzed patient's brain
This Neuralink patient moves a robotic arm without touching anything at all
The brain chip that reads pure thought and turns it into real movement
A woman who cannot move is creating paintings, and the only tool is her mind
caption:
A chip smaller than a coin, placed inside the brain, is letting paralyzed patients paint pictures and control robotic arms using nothing but their thoughts.

Neuralink, Elon Musk's brain implant company, threads tiny electrodes onto the surface of the brain. Those electrodes pick up the electrical signals that fire when a person tries to move. A computer reads those signals in real time and turns them into actual movement, with no hands, no voice, no physical input of any kind.

The woman in this clip has been paralyzed from the neck down for years. She is making art. That is what the device is doing.
